title: Reach labels daily view buckets and host-marked attendance truthfully

source.ref: Authenticated Reach review identified stale visitor and attendance claims; source audit confirmed reader units

detail: Reach now reads status-aware Space profile evidence, preserving null failures rather than displaying zero. Daily page views are signed-in account/UTC-day buckets plus one shared anonymous bucket; taps include repeats and neither metric proves network attribution. Current follower/member totals are distinguished from the trailing window. Canonical standing lever and rules describe roster attendance records, including repeat attendance and succeeded/unrefunded tickets, with unavailable signals excluded from scoring. No scoring, recording, access, DB or production change.

verify.evidence: Four focused suites/58 tests pass: rendered receipt truthful units and unknown states; actual recorders pin account/day/anonymous keys and repeat taps; actual rollup tests prove host marks, held-event window, succeeded/unrefunded tickets and unavailable-read exclusion. Source/mocked only, no browser/production verification.
